verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same flaws. The olive panel behind the headline is gone, so the brand colour survives only as two small olive boxes near the bottom that don't mean anything. The '- SOREN KIERKEGAARD' credit is set almost as big and bold as the quote, which flattens the hierarchy. The white outline frame floats over the church with no link to the text. The only real difference is position: A sits lower, with more empty space at the top and the olive boxes almost touching the bottom edge, while B sits higher and crowds the frame up against the credit line.
